commits.body:
- eslint.config.mjs: register react-hooks/@next-next/jsx-a11y/

  referencing their rules resolve instead of erroring "Definition for
  rule X was not found" (this was the bulk of the 271 errors — most

  comments from an incomplete eslint-config-next migration). Rules
  stay off; this isn't re-enabling Next's full ruleset. Also set
  reportUnusedDisableDirectives: off — without it, --fix treats those
  now-registered-but-off rules' disable comments as "unused" and
  strips them repo-wide (confirmed: touched ~165 files on a first
  pass, reverted before committing).

  syntax errors once the above was fixed. Same pre-existing debt
  category as the rest of that list, not new code.

  glob patterns — square brackets are glob character classes, so the
  unescaped entries silently failed to match their own files.
- src/lib/drizzle/db.ts: fix a fundamentally broken fallback
  connection string (`postgres://localhost:5432/postgres`, no
  credentials) — `neon()` requires user:pass and rejects this in any
  environment without DATABASE_URL set, crashing at import time even
  for DB-free tests that transitively import this module.

  checking for a SQL substring without the `es.` table-alias prefix
  the real (joined) query always has. Verified this is a test bug,
  not a tenancy bug — the underlying query correctly scopes by
  organization_id.
- 19 raw text-[Npx] → named design tokens where one already exists
  for that exact size (text-mini/eyebrow/micro/caption/label), fixing
  the typography ratchet test.
- eslint --fix: remove 74 genuinely-unused imports across the tree.

(down to 9 pre-existing failures, all requiring dedicated follow-up:
raw <button>/color-class/title= ratchets need semantic component
migration; a few tests need a real migrated Postgres to run, which

commits.author: usavsolutionsinc
commits.subject: Make receiving idempotent against retries + concurrent double-fire (BUG-0013/0014)
commits.body:
BUG-0013: receiveLineUnits now short-circuits on a batch-level idempotency
guard — if this client_event_id's per-unit events already exist on the line
(committed by a prior call), return the current state without mutating. The old
per-unit ordinal suffix (`:unit-N`, N from the moving quantity_received) shifted
on retry, so ON CONFLICT(client_event_id) missed and the counter + non-serial
ledger double-applied; only mark-received-po's qty clamp masked it. Now
idempotent for any caller; concurrent dups block on the FOR UPDATE lock then
short-circuit.

BUG-0014: add reserve-up-front idempotency (claimOrReplay / finalize /
release) so two concurrent requests with the same Idempotency-Key can't both
run produce() (which double-called Zoho purchase-receive). The first claims a
pending row; a concurrent second replays the finished response or gets 409
in-progress. Abandoned claims self-heal after a stale window. Additive — the
existing get/save helpers are unchanged (zero blast radius on the other ~34
routes); adopted in mark-received-po at its existing claim/finalize/catch spots.
DB-free unit test covers proceed/replay/in-progress/stale-reclaim/release/5xx.

commits.subject: fix(packing-logs): write pack audit on the tenant txn client via recordAudit
commits.body:
The matched-order and not-found paths wrote the PACK_COMPLETED audit row
with the shared `pool` connection while the station_activity_logs row was
created on the open withTenantTransaction `client`. The uncommitted SAL row
wasn't visible to the separate connection, so the
audit_logs.station_activity_log_id FK violated (23503) and rolled back the
whole pack — surfacing as a 500 on POST /api/packing-logs.

Switch both calls to recordAudit(client, ctx, req, …): runs in the same
transaction (FK resolves) and never throws (audit failures are logged and
dropped), so a future audit hiccup can't roll back a completed pack. Keeps
the historical uppercase entityType literals to preserve audit-dashboard
continuity; action uses AUDIT_ACTION.PACK_COMPLETED (identical value).

commits.author: DENSENSE8
commits.subject: feat(workflow): real per-unit AdvanceLock replacing NULL_LOCK (Phase 1.0)
commits.body:
Best-effort Upstash Redis mutex keyed wf:advance:{serialUnitId}, wired into
the production advance() path. Mirrors api-guard.ts's REST /pipeline shape.

Failure policy (the lock narrows races; engine idempotency is the backstop):
- Redis unconfigured -> acquire() true / release() no-op (== NULL_LOCK), so
  dev/CI/preview are unaffected.
- SET NX miss (already held) -> acquire() false -> 2nd concurrent advance noops.
- Redis error/timeout -> acquire() true (fail OPEN), never stalls a tap.

Short TTL auto-expires a crashed holder; release is a token-checked
compare-and-delete (Lua) so we never free a lock a later advance re-acquired.

commits.body:
Phase 3 (type side) of the platform/type catalog — symmetric to the platform
resolver. A renamed or custom receiving type now prints its catalog label on the
receiving label face (preview + print) instead of the hardcoded slug map.

  receivingLabelTypeDisplay)

field's ~12-surface hybrid footprint belongs with the Phase 2 type_id migration.

commits.author: DENSENSE8
commits.subject: fix(tenancy): set organization_id on Phase B child-table inserts
commits.body:
Migration 2026-06-14_org_id_phase_b_domain_children made organization_id
NOT NULL with a GUC default on receiving / handling-unit / testing / repair /
local-pickup child tables, so inserts that don't set the app.current_org GUC
fail. Attribute org explicitly so those writes keep working:

- receiving_scans, receiving_shipments, testing_results, repair_actions,
  local_pickup_order_items — inherit organization_id from the parent row
  (multi-tenant correct; no GUC dependency)
- handling_units — thread ctx.organizationId via CreateHandlingUnitInput
- local_pickup_orders — ctx.organizationId (route) / USAV for the Zoho
  background sync (transitional, no request ctx)

unit_repairs + repair_failure_resolutions (repairs-queries.ts) are left out —
that file is interleaved with separate in-progress repair work; their identical
org-inherit fix is staged in the working tree to land with that commit.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.title: set organization_id on Phase B child-table inserts

commits.author: DENSENSE8
commits.subject: feat(catalog): per-org editable platform/type catalog
commits.body:
Promote the hardcoded SOURCE_PLATFORMS / RECEIVING_TYPE_OPTS lists into
org-scoped, CRUD-able catalog tables (plan step 1, docs/platform-account-
type-catalog-plan.md) so each org can add / rename / reorder / hide /
delete its own platforms and receiving flow types without a code change.

- migration 2026-06-13g: platforms / platform_accounts / types tables
  (is_system flag; built-ins seeded per org, hide-only + immutable slug)
- /api/catalog/{platforms,types} CRUD — withAuth + Zod + audit + idempotency,
  soft-delete (reads receiving.view, writes admin.manage_features)
- useCatalog hooks + query factory (built-in fallback until seeded)
- CatalogManagerPopover: list + add/rename/reorder/hide-restore/delete,
  opened by a pencil beside the label editor's Platform/Type dropdowns
- carton-bar pills append custom entries
- seedOrgCatalog() provisioning hook on org creation

Read-side (catalog-aware resolvers, RLS, type_id FK) is a follow-up.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.title: per-org editable platform/type catalog
